name: rapidworkers
description: Hire real people for AI data collection (photos, audio, video), app testing and microtasks.
long_description: RapidWorkers connects your AI assistant to people who do paid microtasks on their own devices: AI training data collection (photos, audio, video, text), real-device app and website testing, surveys and native-speaker checks. The assistant gets a cost quote, asks you to confirm it, posts the task, then reviews each submission against your brief. Requires a RapidWorkers API key.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the account balance (USD), whether the account has made a deposit (required before posting jobs), AI task access status and the commission rate added to job costs.

tools.name: get_platform_info
tools.description: Returns platform rules (minimum pay $0.05 per task, $0.10 for AI tasks, $0.50 per survey response, at least 10 workers per job, $20 minimum deposit, commission and fees), job categories with sub-categ

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Returns the 20 most recent balance transactions (deposits, job charges, refunds).

tools.name: get_deposit_link
tools.description: Creates a hosted checkout page and returns its URL for the account owner to open and pay.

tools.name: preview_job_cost
tools.description: Calculates the exact charge for a job, survey or AI task before creating it: pay rate x quantity + commission (+ $10 if a regular job is pinned), whether the balance covers it, and a quote_id valid fo

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Posts a custom job that real workers complete and prove with a screenshot or text.

tools.name: create_prefilled_job
tools.description: Posts a ready-made job from a link, e.g.

tools.name: create_survey
tools.description: Posts a survey that real workers answer on RapidWorkers, built from your questions (choice, dropdown, rating with stars, agree scales or NPS, matrix, ranking, text, number, date, consent, text blocks

tools.name: create_ai_task
tools.description: Posts an AI data-collection task (image, video, audio or text collection, or a custom form) and charges pay_rate x quantity + commission.

tools.name: request_ai_task_access
tools.description: Sends a request to enable AI data-collection tasks for this account, or returns the current status.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Lists the account's jobs with status (Pending, Active, Completed, Canceled, Rejected), progress and pending submission counts, newest first.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns one job, survey or AI task by id with its brief, pay, targeting and progress; for a survey also its questions (keys q_1, q_2, ...

tools.name: extend_job
tools.description: Adds worker slots to a job and charges pay_rate x additional_quantity + commission.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancels a job and refunds the unspent budget to the balance.

tools.name: list_submissions
tools.description: Lists submissions for a job, newest first, filtered by status (Pending, Approved, Rejected).

tools.name: get_survey_results
tools.description: Returns the aggregated results of a survey (job_id from create_survey or list_jobs with kind "survey"): the response funnel (started, screened out, submitted, pending, approved, rejected), median time

tools.name: approve_submission
tools.description: Approves a submission and pays the worker from the job budget; this cannot be undone.

tools.name: reject_submission
tools.description: Rejects a Pending submission; the worker is not paid and sees the reason.

tools.name: approve_all_pending
tools.description: Approves every Pending submission on the job and pays the workers; this cannot be undone.

tools.name: block_worker
tools.description: Blocks a worker (worker_id from list_submissions of a regular job or a survey) from all of the account's jobs and rejects their pending submissions.

tools.name: unblock_worker
tools.description: Removes a worker from the block list.

tools.name: list_blocked_workers
tools.description: Lists the workers this account has blocked.
